svg.title: Disruption and recalibration — Xiaohongshu reach and account ban
svg.desc: A Xiaohongshu public post and a cropped platform notice showing the off-platform traffic rule category. The account was banned and three appeals did not succeed; some customers found the shop through its map listing and existing customers returned.
svg.text: A customer channel—and the rule boundary that closed it
PUBLIC POSTS BEFORE THE ACCOUNT BAN
Notice crop shows the rule category; account identifier is not included.
The ban changed how new customers could find the shop.
Some customers found the shop through its map listing, and existing customers returned. I gradually stepped back
after weighing continued time and labor, expansion costs, learning value, and my longer-term goals.
